text:
sofia: quick q — trying to bundle the redwood-inference client into a Next/Vite edge handler. Works locally but in prod edge I get: 

sofia: `Error: require() of ES Module not supported` when lambda runs. anyone seen a minimal fix?

ben: do you have package.json "type": "module"? or are you importing a CJS entry from ESM? can you paste the import line?

sofia: import { createClient } from 'redwood-inference';
sofia: build log shows something like `.../node_modules/redwood-inference/dist/index.cjs: require is not defined` not sure which side is wrong.

ash: two quick angles: bundler config and SDK exports. For Next edge you want the ESM entry. Check package.json exports of the SDK — if it has conditional exports for "node" vs "default" that can help.

mika: for Vite, try adding `ssr: { noExternal: ['redwood-inference'] }` so Vite doesn't externalize and you end up with mixed module bits. For Next, add `experimental.appDir: true` (if using app router) doesn't change bundling but ensure target is "experimental-edge" if using edge runtime.

ben: if you can, try importing the ESM edge entry directly: 

sofia: 
```
import { createClient } from 'redwood-inference/edge.mjs'
const client = createClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
```

sofia: that actually made the runtime error change — now I get a streaming error instead of require.

ash: streaming quirk: edge runtimes don't support Node-style streaming APIs (res.write). Our SDK falls back to ReadableStream in the edge build, but some bundlers polyfill or strip that. Make sure you use the edge variant which reads/writes using the Web Streams API.

mika: example for reading a streaming response in an edge function: 
```
const res = await client.chat.stream(...)
const reader = res.body.getReader()
while (true) {
  const { done, value } = await reader.read()
  if (done) break
  // value is a Uint8Array chunk
}
```

ben: also check that your deployment's Node/Edge environment supports `globalThis.ReadableStream`. Some providers require a small polyfill in the build step. Avoid polyfilling `process` or `global` in edge bundles, that can flip the build to CJS.

sofia: good call — I had an esbuild plugin that injected `process.env` shim for client builds. Removing it made the bundle smaller and the edge.mjs import work. thanks.

ash: long-term: we should add a note to the SDK README about the recommended import for Next/Vite edge and a short snippet for streaming consumers. I can file a tiny PR.

mika: +1. also add a Vite sample with `ssr.noExternal` and a Next edge note re: `type:module` in package.json if app uses custom build.

infra-bot: deploy queued: edge-function-redwood-sdk-sample — triggered by mika

sofia: i'll try the direct edge import + remove process shim and report back here. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

ben: ping me if it still fails and include the built artifact (the dist/ files) — I can scan exports map and packaging.

sofia: follow-up: removed shim, switched to `/edge.mjs` import, streaming now works in staging. i'll open the PR for README updates and paste the snippet here when ready.
